pt.pt: O ônibus chega na rodoviária de Campos do Jordão.
pt.english: The bus arrives at the Campos do Jordão bus station.
pt.ipa: [u ˈonibus ʃˈeɡæ na xˌodoviˈaɾjæ dʒy kˈɐ̃mpʊz dʊ ʒoɾədˈɐ̃ʊ̃]

pt.pt: Sophie e Lucas descem e pegam um ônibus local para um pequeno vilarejo nas montanhas.
pt.english: Sophie and Lucas get off and take a local bus to a small village in the mountains.
pt.ipa: [sˌofˈij i lˈukæz dˈɛseɪŋ i pˈɛɡɐ̃ʊ̃ ũŋ ˈonibuz lokˈaʊ pˌaɾæ ũŋ pˌekˈenʊ vˌilaɾˈeʒʊ naz mˌoŋtˈɐ̃ɲæs]

pt.english: We finally made it!
Sophie exclaims as she gets off the bus.
Lucas looks around.

pt.pt: É menor do que eu pensava.
pt.english: It's smaller than I thought.
But it's charming and peaceful.
Look at those mountains!

pt.pt: O vilarejo é pitoresco com suas casas de madeira e janelas coloridas.
pt.english: The village is picturesque with its wooden houses and colorful windows.
pt.ipa: [ʊ vˌilaɾˈeʒw ɛ pˌitoɾˈeskʊ koŋ sˌuæs kˈazæz dʒy mˌadˈeɪɾæ i ʒˌænˈɛlæs kˌoloɾˈidæs]

pt.pt: Onde vamos dormir hoje à noite?
pt.english: Where are we going to sleep tonight?
Sophie points.
There's an inn over there.
"Pousada da Serra."
Let's ask if they have rooms.
They enter the inn.

pt.pt: Uma mulher de meia-idade os recebe com um sorriso caloroso.
pt.english: A middle-aged woman greets them with a warm smile.
pt.ipa: [ˌumæ muljˈɛr dʒy mˈeɪæˌidˈadʒj ʊz xˌesˈɛby koŋ ũŋ sˌoxˈizʊ kˌaloɾˈozʊ]

pt.pt: Bom dia, vocês têm dois quartos disponíveis?
pt.english: Good morning, do you have two rooms available?
pt.ipa:
[bˈoŋ dʒˈiæ
 vosˌes teɪŋ dˈoɪs kwˈaɾətʊz dʒˌisponˈiveɪs]

pt.pt: Sim, mas só para hoje à noite.
pt.english: Yes, but only for tonight.
pt.ipa:
[sˈiŋ
 mas sˈɔ pˌaɾæ ˈoʒj ˌaː nˈoɪtʃy]

pt.pt: Amanhã tenho uma reserva de grupo.
pt.english: Tomorrow I have a group reservation.
Perfect, we'll take them.
How much is the daily rate?

pt.pt: Cento e vinte reais por quarto, com café da manhã.
pt.english: One hundred and twenty reais per room, with breakfast included.
pt.ipa:
[sˈeɪŋtw i vˈiŋtʃy xeˈaɪs por kwˈaɾətʊ
 koŋ kafˈɛ da mɐ̃ɲˈɐ̃]

pt.english: Lucas takes out his wallet.
Okay, we'll pay now.

pt.pt: O jantar é servido às sete horas na sala de jantar, explica a dona da pousada.
pt.english: Dinner is served at seven o'clock in the dining room, the inn owner explains.
pt.ipa:
[ʊ ʒɐ̃ŋtˈaɾ ɛ sˌeɾəvˈidw aːs sˈɛtʃy ˈɔɾæz na sˈalæ dʒy ʒɐ̃ŋtˈar
 ˌesplˈikæ a dˈonæ da pˌowzˈadæ]

pt.english: Thank you so much for your help.

pt.pt: Sophie e Lucas sobem com as mochilas para os quartos, depois descem.
pt.english: Sophie and Lucas go up with their backpacks to the rooms, then come back down.
pt.ipa:
[sˌofˈij i lˈukæs sˈɔbeɪŋ koŋ az mˌoʃˈilæs pˌaɾæ ʊs kwˈaɾətʊs
 depˈoɪz dˈɛseɪŋ]

pt.english: Let's explore the village!
